verdict.rationale: The egress docs cover recording to MP4 or HLS, RTMP streaming, auto-start when a room is created, and single-track passthrough. None of them states that multiple participants are composited into one output, and no layout options are documented. Room-level auto-recording only hints at composition, which is not enough to credit the story.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-participant recordings can be composed into a single output with documented layout options
